protocol.advance_rule: First-update gate must be byte-exact and within resource limits. Restart all conditions from the same original checkpoint for the seven-update suite. Stop at first mismatch, unsupported operation, nonfinite value, state leak or resource limit; never fall back to nondeterminism.

amendment.change: Strict deterministic execution, single-update gate, resource measurement and parent-supervised stop. Frozen scientific inputs and original update are reused.
amendment.timing: Declared after auditing the earlier nondeterministic result; before the strict GPU job.

protocol.comparison: Byte-exact repeats within the strict path; descriptive differences are exported on failure. Do not require exact equality to the previous native-kernel path.
protocol.decision: Require exact first-update repeats and resource feasibility before the seven-update suite. Preserve the first mismatch or failure and mark remaining conditions unexecuted. No warning-only mode, fallback, threshold change, resubmission or longer training.
protocol.intervention: Strict deterministic algorithms plus documented cuBLAS workspace; same source detector, fixed checkpoint, data order, pixels, targets and optimizer. Library-dispatched deterministic RoIAlign, no custom kernel or compilation.
limits: One seed/checkpoint/machine and a short trajectory do not establish statistical reproducibility or model efficacy.
Observations synchronize/copy tensors; timings include tracing and are not uninstrumented throughput.
Determinism settings affect multiple operations; passing cannot identify RoIAlign as the unique cause.
No validation/test access, accuracy evaluation, controller redesign, longer training or automatic resubmission.

prior_diagnostic.finding: Plain repeat first differs in backward at update 1; observed probe/restore boundaries and RNG states matched.

protocol.question: Does strict deterministic execution make the same tiny training trajectory repeatable, including the probe and restore paths, within a bounded resource budget?
protocol.resource_rationale: Operational feasibility caps for this one-A10 debugging job, not accuracy or statistical thresholds. Record actual overhead; passing the cap does not mean the path is fast enough for full training.

source_checkpoint.selection: Fixed first unaugmented epoch; not the validation-selected best checkpoint

protocol.treatment: All four conditions use the identical materialized geometry-only batches. Probe policy is recorded but never applied.
